# Git Commit Rules

Full rules: [.agent/rules/commit_rules.md](../../.agent/rules/commit_rules.md)

- Use Conventional Commits: `type(scope): subject` — subject short, modern, friendly, lowercase, no trailing period.
- Add a bullet-point body only when a commit contains many big changes.
- When asked to commit, follow §3 "AI behavior when asked to commit": stage only relevant files, never commit unrelated work-in-progress.
